tone.target: tight Springsteen rock crunch with bright bite and dry punch

tone.summary: A tight signal chain using a Boost/OD for initial grit, followed by an AC30-style amp simulation and a British 4x12 cabinet to achieve the required punchy, mid-focused Springsteen sound.
corrections: keep it more crunch than overdrive
